question: Alternatives to the five shortlisted global publication candidates, including newer scientific products and maintained cloud-native access.
comparison_axes: Measured quantity and intended scientific use
Geometry or grid, temporal record, resolution and coverage definition
Direct substitute, enrichment, complementary product or same-data hosting alternative
Existing cloud-native access, exact product/version and practical reuse
Producer terms and unresolved checks before redistribution
decision_rule: A newer date, finer grid or larger feature count alone does not establish scientific supersession. Prefer existing maintained assets when the intended product and access needs match.
review_limits: Primary documentation and metadata only. No data-body downloads, geometry/raster equivalence tests, private storage, cloud/GEE jobs, external publication or registry mutations.
delegation: Two read-only research tasks: lakes/rivers; climate/glaciers. Root owns surface-water review, synthesis and all file edits.
